```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load all required packages for the entire analysis
library(dplyr)        # Data manipulation
library(ggplot2)      # Visualization
library(stringr)      # String operations
library(tidyr)        # Data reshaping
library(lme4)         # Mixed-effects models
library(emmeans)      # Post-hoc comparisons
library(car)          # Assumption testing (Levene's test)
library(broom.mixed)  # Model summaries
library(VIM)          # Missing data visualization
library(corrplot)     # Correlation plots
library(moments)      # Skewness and kurtosis
library(knitr)        # Nicely formatting tables
library(kableExtra)   # Formatting tables even more nicely

# Set global options for consistent plotting and analysis
theme_set(theme_minimal())
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
set.seed(123)  # For reproducibility
options(contrasts = c("contr.treatment", "contr.poly"))
```

# SECTION 2: DATA CLEANING AND STANDARDIZATION

```{r helper-functions}
# Define all helper functions that will be used throughout the analysis

# Function to convert age from months to years;months format
convert_age <- function(age_months) {
  case_when(
    age_months == 18 ~ "1;06",
    age_months == 22 ~ "1;10",
    age_months == 26 ~ "2;02",
    age_months == 30 ~ "2;06",
    age_months == 34 ~ "2;10",
    TRUE ~ as.character(age_months)
  )
}

# Function to standardize age bins across datasets for comparison
standardize_age_bins <- function(age) {
  case_when(
    age == "2;05" ~ "2;02",
    age == "3;00" ~ "2;10",
    age == "3;03" ~ "3;02",
    age == "3;05" ~ "3;02",
    age == "3;09" ~ "3;06",
    age == "3;11" ~ "3;10",
    age == "4;00" ~ "3;10",
    age == "4;03" ~ "4;02",
    TRUE ~ age  # Keep original value if no match
  )
}

# Function to create proper age ordering for developmental plots
create_age_ordering <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      age = gsub("/.*", "", age),
      age_numeric = as.numeric(sapply(strsplit(age, ";"), function(x) {
        as.numeric(x[1]) * 12 + as.numeric(x[2])
      }))
    ) %>%
    mutate(age = factor(age, levels = unique(age[order(age_numeric)])))
}

# Function to create age bins for developmental analysis
create_age_bins <- function(age_vector) {
  case_when(
    age_vector %in% c("1;06", "1;10") ~ "1;06-1;10",
    age_vector %in% c("2;02", "2;06", "2;10") ~ "2;02-2;10",
    age_vector %in% c("3;02", "3;10") ~ "3;02-3;10",
    TRUE ~ as.character(age_vector)
  )
}

# Function to calculate summary statistics for duration
calculate_summary_stats <- function(data, group_vars) {
  data %>%
    group_by(!!!syms(group_vars)) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_duration = mean(duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_duration = sd(duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# Function to create consistent density plots for duration analysis
create_density_plot <- function(data, group_vars, title, fill_color, line_color, y_limits = c(0, 1.0)) {
  summary_stats <- calculate_summary_stats(data, group_vars)

  ggplot(data, aes(x = duration_sec)) +
    geom_density(fill = fill_color, alpha = 0.5, color = NA) +
    geom_vline(
      data = summary_stats,
      aes(xintercept = mean_duration),
      linetype = "dashed",
      size = 0.8,
      color = line_color
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = summary_stats,
      aes(x = 7.5, y = 0.8,
          label = paste0("M=", round(mean_duration, 2), "\nSD=", round(sd_duration, 2))),
      hjust = 1,
      size = 3,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    facet_grid(reformulate(group_vars[2], group_vars[1])) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Duration (seconds)", y = "Density") +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines")
    ) +
    xlim(0, 8) +
    ylim(y_limits)
}

# Function to create subject-level semantic plots
create_subject_semantic_plot <- function(data, lang_name, title_suffix) {
  semantic_counts <- data %>%
    filter(language == lang_name) %>%
    group_by(subject, age, semantic_cat) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    create_age_ordering()

  ggplot(
    subset(semantic_counts, !is.na(semantic_cat) & semantic_cat != "unclear" & semantic_cat != "other"),
    aes(x = age, y = count, fill = semantic_cat)
  ) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Count of Points in ", title_suffix, ", Split by Subject"),
      x = "Age",
      y = "Count"
    ) +
    scale_fill_discrete(name = "Semantic Category") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
    ) +
    facet_grid(rows = vars(subject), scales = "free_x")
}
```

```{r clean-hearing}
# Clean and standardize HEARING CHILDREN data
hearing_all <- hearing_all %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert age to years;months format
    age = as.factor(age),
    age = convert_age(as.numeric(as.character(age))),

    # Simplify utterance types into two main categories
    simple_utt_type = case_when(
      modality == "Pronouns" ~ NA_character_,
      utt_type == "point_alone" ~ "point alone",
      utt_type %in% c("point+singleword", "point+singleword_pron",
                      "point_in_multiword_utt", "point+pronoun_in_multiword_utt",
                      "point+pronoun_only") ~ "point alongside speech",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # Simplify redundancy categories 
    simple_redundancy = case_when(
      modality == "Pronouns" ~ NA_character_,
      pt_redundancy == "Point Alone" ~ "Point Alone",
      pt_redundancy == "Not Redundant" ~ "Not Redundant",
      pt_redundancy %in% c("Redundant with Pronoun", "Redundant with Other PoS") ~ "Redundant",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # Count words in utterances and bin large utterances (5+ words grouped)
    number_of_words = str_count(c_utts, "\\S+"),
    number_of_words = if_else(number_of_words >= 5, "5+", as.character(number_of_words))
  ) %>%
  relocate(number_of_words, .after = c_utts)  # Organize columns logically

# excluding necessary rows
hearing_all <- hearing_all %>%
  filter(!grepl("exclude", comments, ignore.case = TRUE))
```

```{r clean-deaf}
# Clean and standardize DEAF CHILDREN (ASL) data
deaf_points <- deaf_points %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert duration from milliseconds to seconds for consistency
    duration_sec = as.numeric(duration_sec),

    # Standardize age categories (combine similar ages)
    age = if_else(age %in% c("1;07", "1;06"), "1;06", age),

    # Standardize semantic categories
    semantic_category = if_else(semantic_category == "entity.location", "entity", semantic_category),

    # Handle missing sign counts and bin large utterances
    number_of_signs = if_else(is.na(number_of_signs), 1, number_of_signs),
    number_of_signs = if_else(number_of_signs >= 5, "5+", as.character(number_of_signs))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(duration_sec))  # Remove incomplete duration data
```

```{r clean-homesign}
# Clean and standardize HOMESIGN CHILDREN data
homesign_points <- homesign_points %>%
  mutate(
    # Clean utterance type labels
    Utterance_type = if_else(Utterance_type == "Alone ", "Alone", Utterance_type),

    # Bin large utterances consistently with other datasets
    Number.of.signs = if_else(Number.of.signs >= 5, "5+", as.character(Number.of.signs)),

    # Standardize age bins for cross-dataset comparison
    age = standardize_age_bins(Age),
    age_precise = Age  # Keep original age for reference
  ) %>%
  filter(Subject != "")  # Remove empty entries
```

```{r prepare-and-combine-datasets}
# Prepare all datasets for combination with standardized column names

# Prepare deaf (ASL) data
deaf_points_clean <- deaf_points %>%
  mutate(
    modality = "Points",
    language = "ASL",
    subject = as.character(subject)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    semantic_cat = semantic_category,
    utt_type = utterance_type
  ) %>%
  select(subject, age, utt_type, modality, duration_sec, semantic_cat, language)

# Prepare hearing data
hearing_all_clean <- hearing_all %>%
  mutate(
    language = "English",
    subject = as.character(subject)
  ) %>%
  select(subject, age, utt_type, modality, duration_sec, semantic_cat, language)

# Prepare homesign data
homesign_points_clean <- homesign_points %>%
  mutate(
    language = "Homesign",
    modality = "Points"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    duration_sec = `Duration...ss.msec`,
    utt_type = Utterance_type
  ) %>%
  select(subject = Subject, age, utt_type, modality, duration_sec, language, semantic_cat)

# Combine all datasets into one unified dataframe
combined_df <- bind_rows(hearing_all_clean, deaf_points_clean, homesign_points_clean) %>%
  mutate(
    # Final standardization of age format
    age = if_else(
      grepl("^\\d+$", age),
      paste(floor(as.numeric(age) / 12), sprintf("%02d", as.numeric(age) %% 12), sep = ";"),
      age
    ),
    # Standardize utterance type names
    utt_type = case_when(
      utt_type == "point" ~ "point_alone",
      utt_type == "Alone" ~ "point_alone",
      TRUE ~ utt_type
    )
  )
```

```{r}
### SUMMARY TABLES BY AGE AND GROUP
## HELPER FUNCTION: FORMAT AGE FOR DISPLAY
format_age <- function(age) {
  if(is.numeric(age)) {
    years <- floor(age)
    months <- round((age - years) * 12)
    return(paste0(years, ";", sprintf("%02d", months)))
  } else {
    return(age)
  }
}

## HELPER FUNCTION: CREATE GROUP SUMMARY DATA
create_group_summary <- function(data, subject_col, age_col, group_name, averaged = FALSE) {
  subject_col <- sym(subject_col)
  age_col <- sym(age_col)

  if (averaged) {
    # Calculate mean points per subject within each age
    summary_data <- data %>%
      group_by(!!age_col, !!subject_col) %>%
      summarise(points_per_subject = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
      group_by(!!age_col) %>%
      summarise(
        n_children = n_distinct(!!subject_col),
        value = round(mean(points_per_subject), 1),
        .groups = 'drop'
      )
  } else {
    # Calculate total children and total points per age
    summary_data <- data %>%
      group_by(!!age_col) %>%
      summarise(
        n_children = n_distinct(!!subject_col),
        value = n(),
        .groups = 'drop'
      )
  }

  summary_data %>%
    mutate(
      age_formatted = sapply(!!age_col, format_age),
      group = group_name,
      display = paste0(n_children, " (", value, ")")
    ) %>%
    select(age = !!age_col, age_formatted, group, display, value, n_children)
}

## TOTALS TABLE: CHILDREN AND TOTAL POINTS PRODUCED
# Process English-learners (hearing children learning English)
english_summary <- hearing_all_clean %>%
  filter(modality == "Points") %>%
  create_group_summary("subject", "age", "English-learners", averaged = FALSE)

# Process ASL-learners (deaf children learning American Sign Language)
asl_summary <- deaf_points %>%
  create_group_summary("subject", "age", "ASL-learners", averaged = FALSE)

# Process Homesigners (deaf children not exposed to conventional sign language)
homesign_summary <- homesign_points %>%
  create_group_summary("Subject", "Age", "Homesigners", averaged = FALSE)

# Add individual homesigner breakdowns with indentation
homesign_individuals <- homesign_points %>%
  group_by(Subject, Age) %>%
  summarise(n_points = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(
    age_formatted = sapply(Age, format_age),
    group = paste0("    → ", Subject),
    display = paste0("1 (", n_points, ")"),
    value = n_points,
    n_children = 1
  ) %>%
  select(age = Age, age_formatted, group, display, value, n_children)

# Combine all data
all_summary <- bind_rows(english_summary, asl_summary, homesign_summary, homesign_individuals)

# Create wide format table
all_ages <- sort(unique(all_summary$age))
age_labels <- sapply(all_ages, format_age)

summary_table <- all_summary %>%
  select(group, age_formatted, display) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = age_formatted, values_from = display, values_fill = "") %>%
  left_join(
    all_summary %>%
      group_by(group) %>%
      summarise(total_points = sum(value), .groups = 'drop'),
    by = "group"
  )

# Format and display totals table
summary_table %>%
  left_join(
    # Calculate mean points per child for each group
    bind_rows(
      # English-learners: mean points per individual child (count rows)
      hearing_all_clean %>%
        filter(modality == "Points") %>%
        group_by(subject) %>%
        summarise(child_total_points = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%  # Count rows instead of sum(value)
        summarise(group = "English-learners",
                  mean_points_per_child = round(mean(child_total_points, na.rm = TRUE), 0)),

      # ASL-learners: mean points per individual child (count rows)
      deaf_points_clean %>%  # Using deaf_points_clean based on your colnames() call
        filter(modality == "Points") %>%
        group_by(subject) %>%
        summarise(child_total_points = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%  # Count rows instead of sum(value)
        summarise(group = "ASL-learners",
                  mean_points_per_child = round(mean(child_total_points, na.rm = TRUE), 0)),

      # Homesigners: mean points per individual child (count rows)
      homesign_points %>%
        group_by(Subject) %>%
        summarise(child_total_points = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%  # Count rows instead of sum(value)
        summarise(group = "Homesigners",
                  mean_points_per_child = round(mean(child_total_points, na.rm = TRUE), 0))
    ),
    by = "group"
  ) %>%
  kable(
    caption = "Table 1. Number of children in each group observed at each session and (in parentheses) number of points produced",
    align = c("l", rep("c", length(age_labels)), "c", "c"),
    col.names = c("Child Group", age_labels, "Total Points", "Mean Points per Child"),
    format = "html"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center"
  ) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Age at Observation (years;months)" = length(age_labels), " " = 2)) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#f0f0f0") %>%
  row_spec(which(grepl("→", summary_table$group)),
           italic = TRUE, color = "#888888", background = "#f5f5f5") %>%
  footnote(
    general = "* The English-learners were observed at the ages listed in the table; because of the difficulty of scheduling the ASL-learners and Homesigners, they were visited sometime  within the 4-month intervals (on occasion, a child was observed twice within this interval)We extended the observation period for homesigners because they can be delayed by as much as a year (e.g., Morford & Goldin-Meadow, 1997) ",
    general_title = "Note: "
  )
```

```{r redundancy-analysis}
# Analyze point redundancy in hearing children (preliminary descriptive analysis)
pt_redundancy_stats <- hearing_all %>%
  filter(modality == "Points") %>%
  mutate(pt_redundancy = case_when(
    pt_redundancy %in% c("Redundant with Pronoun", "Redundant with Other PoS") ~ "Redundant",
    pt_redundancy == "unclear" ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE ~ pt_redundancy
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pt_redundancy)) %>%
  group_by(subject, age, pt_redundancy) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(pt_redundancy) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_count = mean(count),
    sd_count = sd(count),
    total_count = sum(count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * total_count / sum(total_count))

# Create formatted kable table with HTML formatting
kable(pt_redundancy_stats,
      caption = "Redundancy of Point Gestures for Hearing Children",
      digits = 2,
      align = "c",
      format = "html",
      table.attr = "style='border-collapse: collapse; border: 1px solid black; margin: 0 auto;'") %>%
  gsub("<td ", "<td style='border: 1px solid black; padding: 8px; text-align: center;' ", .) %>%
  gsub("<th ", "<th style='border: 1px solid black; padding: 8px; text-align: center; background-color: #f0f0f0;' ", .)

```

```{r multiword-analysis}
###HEARING
# Create the proportion table
proportion_table <- hearing_all %>%
  # Create binary variable for single word (1) vs multi-word (>1)
  mutate(single_word = ifelse(number_of_words == 1, 1, 0)) %>%
  # Group by subject and age
  group_by(subject, age) %>%
  # Calculate proportion of multi-word utterances as percentage
  summarise(
    prop_multi_word = (1 - mean(single_word, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  # Pivot to wide format with subjects as rows, ages as columns
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = age,
    values_from = prop_multi_word
  ) %>%
  # Round to 1 decimal place for clean display
  mutate(across(-subject, ~ round(.x, 1)))

# Create formatted kable table with HTML formatting
kable(proportion_table,
      caption = "English Group: Percentage of multiword utterances",
      digits = 1,
      align = "c",
      format = "html",
      table.attr = "style='border-collapse: collapse; border: 1px solid black; margin: 0 auto;'") %>%
  gsub("<td ", "<td style='border: 1px solid black; padding: 8px; text-align: center;' ", .) %>%
```

```{r basic-plots}
# VISUALIZATION 1: Overall counts by language group
count_data <- combined_df %>%
  group_by(subject, age, modality, language) %>%

avg_data <- count_data %>%
  group_by(language, modality) %>%

plot1 <- ggplot(avg_data, aes(x = language, y = avg_count, fill = modality)) +

  ) +
  scale_fill_discrete(na.translate = FALSE) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

avg_data_age <- count_data %>%
  group_by(language, modality, age) %>%
  summarise(avg_count = mean(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!is.na(avg_count) & avg_count > 0) %>%
  create_age_ordering()

plot2 <- ggplot(avg_data_age, aes(x = age, y = avg_count, fill = modality)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(
```

```{r verify-item3-semantic-logistic}
# VERIFY Item 3: Mixed-effects logistic regression on semantic category use
# Tests whether language group predicts entity vs. other pointing.
# Manuscript reports: N = 4,043, chi2(2) = 4.79, p = 0.091
# Random intercepts for participant and age (age treated as factor grouping variable).

sem_log_data <- combined_df %>%
  filter(modality == "Points", !is.na(language), !is.na(semantic_cat),
         semantic_cat != "unclear") %>%
  mutate(
    language_group = factor(case_when(
      language == "English"  ~ "English-learners",
      language == "ASL"      ~ "ASL-learners",
      language == "Homesign" ~ "Homesigners"
    ), levels = c("English-learners", "ASL-learners", "Homesigners")),
    entity_bin = as.integer(semantic_cat == "entity"),
    subject    = factor(subject),
    age_fac    = factor(age)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(language_group))

cat("=== VERIFY Item 3: Semantic Logistic Regression ===\n\n")
cat("Sample sizes (unclear excluded):\n")
sem_log_data %>%
  group_by(language_group) %>%
  summarise(N = n(), subjects = n_distinct(subject), .groups = "drop") %>%
  print()
cat("Total N:", nrow(sem_log_data), "\n\n")

sem_log_null <- glmer(entity_bin ~ (1 | subject) + (1 | age_fac),
                      data = sem_log_data, family = binomial,
                      control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
sem_log_full <- glmer(entity_bin ~ language_group + (1 | subject) + (1 | age_fac),
                      data = sem_log_data, family = binomial,
                      control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

cat("Likelihood ratio test (null vs. full model with language group):\n")
print(anova(sem_log_null, sem_log_full))
```

```{r}
            aes(x = 7, y = y_pos,

  scale_color_manual(values = c("English" = "#F8766D", "ASL" = "#00BA38", "Homesign" = "#619CFF"),
                     name = "Language") +
  facet_wrap(~ entity_group, ncol = 1) +
  labs(title = "Duration of all points",
       x = "Duration (seconds)", y = "Density") +
  xlim(0, 8) + ylim(0, 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# DETAILED DURATION PLOTS BY AGE AND LANGUAGE
# =============================================================================
# Simplified density plot function with mean and SD labels
create_density_plot <- function(data, group_vars, fill_color, y_limits = c(0, 1.0), plot_type = "general") {

  # Apply custom labels based on plot type
  plot_data <- data
  if (plot_type == "ASL") {
    plot_data <- plot_data %>%
      mutate(subject = paste0("ASL", as.numeric(as.factor(subject))))
  } else if (plot_type == "Homesign") {
    plot_data <- plot_data %>%
      mutate(subject = paste0("HS", as.numeric(as.factor(subject))))
  } else if (plot_type == "general") {
    plot_data <- plot_data %>%
      mutate(language = case_when(
        language == "English" ~ "English-learners",
        language == "ASL" ~ "ASL-learners",
        language == "Homesign" ~ "Homesigners",
        TRUE ~ language
      ))
  }

  # Calculate the maximum density to set appropriate y-limits
  max_density <- plot_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(duration_sec)) %>%  # Remove missing values
    group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) %>%
    do({
      clean_data <- .$duration_sec[!is.na(.$duration_sec)]
      if(length(clean_data) > 1) {
        dens <- density(clean_data, from = 0, to = 6)
        data.frame(max_dens = max(dens$y))
      } else {
        data.frame(max_dens = 0)
      }
    }) %>%
    pull(max_dens) %>%
    max(na.rm = TRUE)

  # Set y_limits to accommodate the highest density, with some padding
  y_limits_auto <- c(0, max(1.0, max_density * 1.1))

  # Calculate session means (remove NA values)
  session_stats <- plot_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(duration_sec)) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) %>%
    summarise(session_mean = mean(duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

  # Calculate mean and SD for each facet (only for facets with data)
  facet_stats <- plot_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(duration_sec)) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_val = mean(duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_val = sd(duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_obs = n(),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    filter(n_obs > 0) %>%  # Only keep facets with data
    mutate(
      stats_label = paste0("M = ", round(mean_val, 2), "\nSD = ", round(sd_val, 2))
    )

  # Base plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = duration_sec)) +
    geom_density(fill = fill_color, alpha = 0.5, color = NA) +
    facet_grid(reformulate(group_vars[2], group_vars[1]), drop = TRUE) +
    labs(x = "Duration (seconds)", y = "Density") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines")
    ) +
    xlim(0, 6) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), limits = y_limits_auto)

  # Add mean and SD text labels (only for facets with data)
  p <- p + geom_text(data = facet_stats,
                     aes(x = 4.5, y = y_limits_auto[2] * 0.8, label = stats_label),
                     hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3, color = "black")

  # Add reference lines based on plot type
  if (plot_type == "general") {
    # Royal blue 1: session means for each age-language combination
    p <- p +
      geom_vline(data = session_stats, aes(xintercept = session_mean),
                 linetype = "dotted", size = 0.8, color = "royalblue1")

    # Black: overall means for each language across all sessions
    overall_language_means <- plot_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(duration_sec)) %>%
      group_by(across(all_of(group_vars[2]))) %>%  # group by language only
      summarise(overall_mean = mean(duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

    # Expand to all existing age-language combinations
    existing_combos <- plot_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(duration_sec)) %>%
      group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) %>%
      summarise(n_obs = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
      filter(n_obs > 0)

    overall_stats <- existing_combos %>%
      select(all_of(group_vars)) %>%
      left_join(overall_language_means, by = group_vars[2])

    p <- p + geom_vline(data = overall_stats, aes(xintercept = overall_mean),
                       linetype = "dotted", size = 0.8, color = "black")

  } else if (plot_type == "ASL") {
    # Royal blue 1: mean for each age-subject facet
    p <- p +
      geom_vline(data = session_stats, aes(xintercept = session_mean),
                 linetype = "dotted", size = 0.8, color = "royalblue1")

    # Black: mean for ASL-learners at each age (across all subjects)
    asl_age_means <- plot_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(duration_sec)) %>%
      group_by(across(all_of(group_vars[1]))) %>%  # group by age only
      summarise(age_mean = mean(duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

    # Expand to all existing age-subject combinations
    existing_combos <- plot_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(duration_sec)) %>%
      group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) %>%
      summarise(n_obs = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
      filter(n_obs > 0)

    age_stats <- existing_combos %>%
      select(all_of(group_vars)) %>%
      left_join(asl_age_means, by = group_vars[1])

    p <- p + geom_vline(data = age_stats, aes(xintercept = age_mean),
                       linetype = "dotted", size = 0.8, color = "black")

  } else if (plot_type == "Homesign") {
    # Royal blue 1: mean for each age-subject facet
    p <- p +
      geom_vline(data = session_stats, aes(xintercept = session_mean),
                 linetype = "dotted", size = 0.8, color = "royalblue1")
  }

  return(p)
}

# Function to save plots
save_plot <- function(plot_obj, filename) {
  ggsave(paste0("/Users/jessbreeze/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Pointing project 2025/analysis/TEMP_PP_sanity_check_Aug25/plots/", filename, ".png"),
         plot = plot_obj, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
}
```
